meta.description: Tracxn teaser enrichment workflow. Accepts a batch of vendor objects, derives a Tracxn slug from the website domain or vendor name, fetches the teaser page, extracts founded/hq_address/funding_stage/total_funding via regex, and safe-upserts via /admin/enrich-write. Skips vendors where all 4 fields are already populated. Requires n8n variables: ADMIN_API_BASE_URL, ADMIN_API_TOKEN.
